title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources and surface audit logs when region mismatches are detected. Includes migration and rollout plan; opt-in policy flag available during canary.
description: Background: Customers with strict data residency and KMS residency requirements need RBAC v2 resources (service accounts, roles referencing KMS keys) to be pinned to a KMS region and to emit audit events when mismatches occur. This PR implements server-side enforcement for KMS region pinning, augments audit logging to record region decisions, and adds a migration/rollout path to avoid breaking existing tenants. Summary of changes: 1) validation layer: added policy validator that checks KMS key region metadata against resource region and RBAC policy constraints; 2) enforcement toggle: new cluster-level config `rbac.v2.kms_enforce_region_pinning` (false by default) and an opt-in org-level override for canary customers; 3) audit logging: extended audit schema to include `kms_region`, `resource_region`, `policy_id`, and `pinning_decision` with reasons; 4) migration: a safety migration that scans existing RBAC v2 entries and writes warnings to audit logs; 5) e2e and unit tests + SDK type updates + docs updates. Rollout plan: land behind feature flag, run migration in read-only mode for 48h, enable enforcement for 5% of orgs, monitor audit and errors via Console dashboards and alerting (ENG-2345). Backfill plan: when enforcement is enabled, migrations that detect mismatches will either auto-fail resource updates or surface a remediation link in the Console. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] canary config, [x] docs, [x] migration script, [x] monitoring dashboards. Motivation: closes security/regulatory gaps for EU/UK/CA customers and simplifies operator expectations. See linked Linear tickets ENG-2345 and SEC-112 for threat model and customer requests.

review_comments: Jonah Kim: Could you split the validator into a pure validation package so other callers (CLI & importer) can reuse the logic? Also please add a unit test for cross-region key alias lookup; if the KMS alias points to a different region we should surface that in the audit message.
Asha Patel (author): Split validator into validator/core and validator/integration in latest commit; added alias lookup test and clarified audit message format.
Priya Rao: The migration scans could produce a lot of noise for large tenants; can we rate-limit or sample? Also request to add a nightly job to reconcile fixes.
Asha Patel: Migration now supports sampling mode and writes an aggregated summary at the end of run. Added a follow-up Linear task (ENG-2410) to implement nightly reconciliation.
Luca Moretti: Are there any performance implications for policy evaluation in hot paths? Please ensure cheap-path short-circuits when no KMS key is present.

Asha Patel: Added micro-benchmarks to the PR and a short-circuit in validator when resource does not reference an external KMS key. Benchmarks show <0.8% p50 latency impact on policy evaluation for typical requests.
migration_instructions: Run `rbac_v2_kms_region_scan` in dry-run mode against prod DB (admin-only). Review aggregated summary and create remediation tickets. When enabled, enforcement will reject create/update operations that reference mismatched KMS regions; provide remediation link in Console to rebind to a compliant key or request org override.
testing_and_qa: Unit + integration + e2e added. Benchmarks included. SRE ran a 24h canary with 5% traffic and no regressions observed. Monitoring: new dashboard rbac_kms_region_pin + alerts on pinning_denied_count and migration_scan_error_rate.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: enforcement could block legitimate cross-region workflows. Mitigation: default off, org-level opt-in, sampling migration, clear remediation links, rollback toggle and emergency runbook documented in DOCS-SEC-ENFORCE.
notes: This PR is part of the broader RBAC v2 hardening and KMS residency program (see series ENG-2230). Follow-up tasks: nightly reconciliation job (ENG-2410), SDK error code harmonization (ENG-2422).
